Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a compromised machine and demands ransom in Monero cryptocurrency (XMR) to decrypt the affected files
Attack Vector: Uses social engineering to trick victims into running the ransomware or exploits for vulnerabilities in software or hardware to elevate privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted by Redeemer have a “.redeem” file extension and leave a ransom note in Read Me.TXT

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a compromised machine and demands that victims pay a ransom in Bitcoin for file decryption
Attack Vector: Not specified, but implies execution on compromised machines
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted by Beamed have a “.beamed” file extension and leave a ransom note in “RIP YO DOCUMENTS.txt”

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a victim’s machine, deletes shadow copies, claims to have stolen information from the victim
Attack Vector: Not specified, but implies execution on compromised machines
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted by Araicrypt have a “.araicrypt” file extension and leave a ransom note in “READ_TO_RESTORE_YOUR_FILES.txt”
